text:
Complete phosphocreatine resynthesis after very high-intensity exercise normally takes about 3–5 minutes, and sometimes up to about 8 minutes depending on fitness and the effort. Half is restored in roughly 20–30 seconds, so the team note saying it is restored "within seconds" is incorrect. Resynthesis is oxidative and depends on mitochondrial ATP, which is why full recovery takes minutes.

CONFIDENCE: 75
